title: Speech TTS/STT is a sibling semantic service over Audio execution material
summary: ooRexx Speech consumes and produces PCM/audio execution material without absorbing Layered Audio, Storage, SIP, RTP or device authority. Speech intentions are discovered from the live SpeechRuntime and retain exact channel objects rather than a cached action catalogue.
invariants: Layered Audio owns AudioRecording, AudioElement, AudioView, processing lineage and acoustic evidence; Speech owns TTS/STT channel/session semantics.

Speech may consume a transient Layered Audio execution binding through localPath while preserving its durable identityKey as lineage metadata; transient paths never become authoritative Audio identity.
Speech does not own SIP dialogs, RTP packetization/codecs or ALSA/PipeWire device authority. Those systems compose through PCM source/sink seams.
Python providers remain resident behind Python Macrospace. One resident provider object per speech lane is the default concurrency rule unless a backend is independently qualified for sharing.
Streaming TTS/STT carries bulk PCM outside the scalar Macrospace marshaller; only bounded descriptors/session events cross the scalar bridge.
Speech intention discovery is dynamic. Each discovery re-reads the live SpeechRuntime, current lane state and exact channel objects; a stale permanent action catalogue is not authoritative.
A duplex-session intention exists only when independent TTS and STT lanes are currently available. Busy or removed channels change the next discovery.
Low-level ASR output remains a speech hypothesis, not proof that ambiguous or low-SNR source audio contains the recognized words. Layered Audio evidence/assessment semantics remain separate.
procedure: For Audio-backed STT, materialise through the Audio/Storage execution authority, pass the transient localPath/PCM into Speech, retain identityKey in Speech artifact metadata, and release the execution binding through its owner.
For live telephony, hand decoded S16LE PCM between RTP/device adapters and Speech. RTP keeps G.711 framing/timing; Speech keeps recognition/synthesis semantics.
Before presenting Speech actions to Intention Service, perform a fresh SpeechIntentionProvider discovery against the current SpeechRuntime rather than reusing a prior snapshot.

provenance.claim: Qualified provider-neutral batch/streaming TTS/STT, Azure Macrospace providers, telephony PCM profiles, Audio execution bridge, local PCM controller and full-duplex session orchestration.
Adds fresh SpeechRuntime intention discovery retaining exact live TTS/STT channel objects; strict static standards gate PASS, exact r13196 runtime execution pending in the current container.
Current Audio execution binding preserves durable identityKey while exposing transient localPath materialisation.
